composites.name: disintegration-spatial
composites.description: The disintegration study flagship: a single coherent CPM cell (CpmDisintegration, no metabolism/cobra path) sits centered on a shared 60x60 fields grid inside a radial stressor gradient -- low at the grid center (where the cell is seeded) and rising toward the periphery (peak 1.5, ring onset at radius 5, saturating at radius 18) -- diffusing under spatio-flux DiffusionAdvection (D=4.0, no-flux/neumann boundary on all sides, so total stressor mass is conserved and simply relaxes toward its spatial mean). Each tick the cell reads mean stressor over its own CPM footprint; as the peripheral stressor diffuses inward the footprint-local mean rises and crosses viability_threshold=0.5 around tick 6-7, LATCHING the release flag. Once released, the process resorbs the cell toward zero target volume (resorb_per_tick=6.0) and sheds each tick's vacated footprint pixels as debris particles (up to 8/tick) into a shared map[particle] store, which a stock spatio-flux BrownianMovement then scatters. The cell fully dissolves (area -> 0) roughly 9-10 ticks after release, so a ~20-tick run shows hold -> cross -> resorb -> scatter end to end. Timing verified by direct Composite(...).run(N) inspection of state["obs"] during authoring (released_tick ~= 7, area == 0 by ~tick 16).

composites.name: Biofilm Development — Draft Interface
composites.description: Fig 10.2 (panels c/d) — biofilm development as a hierarchical reorganization. Cells attach to a surface (SurfaceAttachment), the attached population secretes extracellular matrix (ECMSecretion), and the matrix-embedded community grows into a structured biofilm (BiofilmGrowth). All three processes act on leaves inside a single `biofilm` store nested in the environment — the individual cellular interfaces become part of a collective (biofilm) interface that couples, as one composite, to the surrounding environment. All draft processes: unit-bearing ports + behavior contracts, no dynamics.

composites.description: The composed whole cell — the paper figure mechanisms (thermal environment, uptake, a selectable Fig 6 metabolism [coarse | kinetic | FBA], a viability monitor, DNA-threshold division Fig 10-1, and disintegration) wired through shared cell/environment stores. composites.name: cellcell-crossfeed
composites.description: A tuned two-role cross-feeding pair (CpmColonyField) on a shared 60x60 grid demonstrating a metabolic handoff. A 'secretor' CPM cell runs the flagship microaerobic e_coli_core loop -- dynamic MM-limited glucose uptake (glucose_vmax 10.0) with O2 capped hard at 5.0 to force maximal mixed-acid acetate overflow -- and is fed by a LOCALIZED glucose depot (20.0 mM in the left columns 0-18, zero elsewhere) so glucose never reaches the consumer and the secretor plateaus once the depot is spent. A 'consumer' CPM cell has its glucose exchange fixed off (role-driven) and instead runs dynamic MM-limited ACETATE uptake (acetate_vmax 20.0) with O2 uncapped-ish (oxygen_vmax 20.0) to respire it. The two cells are seeded ~6 lattice cells apart (secretor x8-16, consumer x22-30) and acetate carries a high diffusion coefficient (15.0, vs glucose 0.4) so the secretor's plume crosses the open field and reaches the consumer's footprint before it starves. Over a 20-step run the consumer sits at ~zero local glucose, its local acetate rises as the plume arrives, and it net-grows on acetate alone (biomass 1.25 -> ~3.8). Regime tuned + asserted in task 4 (tests/test_cellcell_regimes.py).

composites.name: Evolution — Draft Interface
composites.description: Fig 10.3 (panels e/f) — evolution reshapes the composition itself. Discrete driving events introduce variation (Variation), selection favors interfaces that sustain viability and fitness (Selection), and new interface capabilities arise through the addition of a port (PortAddition). The environment holds several cell variants: an ancestral cell^ecoli and a derived cell^O157 that has gained an extra `new_port` (and `identity`) leaf its ancestor lacks — a new mode of interaction with the environment, not just a changed value. Evolution thus expands the space of possible organizations through new ports, couplings, and rewrites. All draft processes: unit-bearing ports + behavior contracts, no dynamics (variation/port-addition described as driving-event rewrites in the contracts, not implemented).

composites.name: Self-Organization & Coarse-Graining
composites.description: Fig 9a — self-organization, coarse-graining, and autopoiesis. Three functions — metabolism, containment, replication — each drawn at three grains, so that lumping a self-organized process (autocatalysis; membrane self-assembly; template replication) recovers its coarse closure. Read across, the three columns are autopoiesis: metabolism powers the boundary and the copying, containment concentrates both, replication reproduces the machinery they need. All draft processes: unit-bearing ports + behavior contracts, no update dynamics.

composites.name: A Molecular Mechanism
composites.description: Fig 7b/7c — a molecular mechanism as a process with typed physical channels. Fig 7b: the molecular interface exchanges matter (chemical, mol·s⁻¹), charge (electrical, C·s⁻¹/A), momentum (mechanical, kg·m·s⁻²/N), and energy (thermal, J·s⁻¹/W), and is defined over molecular structure (PDB/SMILES) — no cell-level boundary. Fig 7c: the chemical channel refines into specialized subports — substrates, cofactors, catalysts, products. The mechanism is wired to a `ports` store (the typed channels + structure) and a `subports` store (the chemical refinement). draft process: unit-bearing ports + behavior contract, no update dynamics.

composites.name: cellcell-compete
composites.description: Two competitor CPM cells (CpmColonyField) share one 60x60 glucose field and race for the same nutrient via independent per-cell dFBA. Both cells run the microaerobic e_coli_core role ('competitor'): dynamic MM-limited glucose uptake capped by their own glucose_vmax (10.0 for the left/fast competitor, 4.0 for the right/slow competitor), O2 capped to force mixed-acid acetate overflow, exactly like the flagship single-cell loop. Seeded left/right in non-overlapping half-open seed_blocks over a uniform ~3.0 mM glucose field so early dynamics aren't gradient-biased -- any asymmetry in growth traces back to the vmax difference, not seed position. Acetate is tracked as the shared byproduct field (diffuses away, not consumed by either competitor). Structural build target for task 3; regime tuning / competitive-exclusion assertions are task 4.

composites.name: single-cell-in-a-field
composites.description: The flagship spatial sense/act loop: a single CPM cell (CpmCellField) sits in a left-low-to-right-high glucose gradient on a shared 60x60 fields grid, diffusing under spatio-flux DiffusionAdvection. Each tick the cell reads local glucose over its footprint, runs one dFBA step (e_coli_core, O2-capped to force mixed-acid overflow), grows its CPM volume from the biomass it makes, and writes uptake (-glucose) / secretion (+acetate) back into the field as a spatial delta. Diffusion then redistributes both species: glucose flows in from the higher-concentration side to partially resupply the depleted halo around the cell, and the secreted acetate spreads outward into a plume. Tuned for GRADUAL, nutrient-limited, spatially-legible dynamics (a roomy grid, a real depletion halo, modest net consumption) rather than lattice-filling growth -- this is the run meant to become the flagship GIF (Fig 5 cell-environment coupling / niche construction, realized spatially).

composites.name: Cell Division — Draft Interface
composites.description: Fig 10.1 (panel b) — division as a compositional rewrite. A prokaryotic cell replicates its chromosome (DNAReplication), segregates the copies toward the two poles (SegregateChromosome), and then splits — an event-driven graph rewrite (Divide) — partitioning state (DNA, biomass) into two daughters and incrementing the cell count. The daughters live as sibling stores under the shared environment, each re-coupling its own interface to it: division does not sever the coupling, it partitions the composition while the daughters remain coupled through the shared environment. All draft processes: unit-bearing ports + behavior contracts, no dynamics (division/segregation described as event rewrites in the contracts, not implemented).

composites.name: cell-sorting-spatial
composites.description: The sorting study flagship: a mixed 8x8 checkerboard of alternating-type 5x5-px CPM cells (64 cells total, 32 type-1 / 32 type-2, on a 70x70 lattice) demixes under differential-adhesion contact energetics alone (CpmSorting, the verified checkerboard config from tests/test_cpm_sorting.py) -- NO fields, NO metabolism/cobra path, this is the sorting *primitive* in isolation. Contact energies are tuned Steinberg-style: same-type contact is cheap (J(1,1)=J(2,2)=2.0), cross-type contact is expensive (J(1,2)=11.0), and contact with medium sits in between (J(0,1)=J(0,2)=8.0) -- so cells minimize free energy by clustering with their own type and pulling away from the other, at temperature=10.0 (Metropolis fluctuation scale). Each tick runs 10 Monte Carlo steps (mcs) of CPM copy attempts; hetero_frac (the fraction of intercell 4-neighbor lattice edges between two DIFFERENT live cells) collapses from its well-mixed checkerboard starting value toward a sorted low value while cell_pixels (the cohesion guard) and the per-type cell counts stay constant -- verified end-to-end in tests/test_cpm_sorting.py's Composite run.

composites.name: Interaction Modalities
composites.description: Fig 4a — four interaction-modality cards of the cellular interface: nutrient exchange (chemical flux), motile force (mechanical), growth rate, and electrical signaling. Each is a draft process: unit-bearing ports + a behavior contract, no update dynamics. Ports are wired to labeled stores so each quantity (and its unit) appears as a node.

composites.name: growth-division-spatial
composites.description: A single CPM cell (CpmGrowthDivision) grows via per-cell dFBA on an abundant, uniform 60x60 glucose field (spatio-flux DiffusionAdvection) and divides at a volume threshold using the native engine call divide_cells, compounding into a small lineage over the run. Tuned (glucose_vmax=1.5, vol_threshold=80, reset_target=40) for a clean 1->2->4->8->16 division staircase without runaway past the lattice.

composites.name: The Minimal Cell
composites.description: Fig 9b — the minimal cell: the three columns of Fig 9a wired into one composite. Four processes — containment (lipids→membrane), metabolism (enzymes+nutrients→metabolites+energy), gene expression (genes→proteins+enzymes), and replication (genes+energy→gene copies) — are coupled through shared pools, with generic diffusion and mass-action reactions keeping the building-block stores supplied. Metabolism powers replication and expression supplies metabolism's enzymes: this mutual dependence through shared components is the minimal form of autopoietic closure. All draft processes: unit-bearing ports + behavior contracts, no update dynamics.

composites.name: Cell Disintegration
composites.description: Fig 6b — cell disintegration as a grain-swap equivalence. A cell-level coarse-grained metabolism process and a molecular catalyzed-reaction network realize the same external interface at two different grains of description: coarse ⇄ fine. Lump the closed catalytic loops of the reaction network and you recover the coarse metabolism process; disintegrate the coarse process and you recover the network. Both grains are shown side by side, each wired to its own store cluster. All draft processes: unit-bearing ports + behavior contracts, no update dynamics.

composites.name: Nested Molecular Hierarchy
composites.description: Fig 8b — molecular compositions as a nested hierarchical composite. Molecular structure is organized as a nested place-graph across scales: an extracellular matrix, a membrane, and a cytoplasm containing a nucleus (chromosome → chromatin → nucleosome → DNA/histone), organelles (a ribosomal complex, mitochondria, secretory organelles), and cytoplasmic pools (proteins, RNA, enzymes, metabolites, nutrients). Six draft processes act on leaves deep inside this hierarchy — transmembrane transport across the membrane, replication/repair and transcription in the nucleus, metabolism and translation in the cytoplasm, and assembly of subunits into the ribosomal complex — so the topology reads like Fig 8b. All draft processes: unit-bearing ports + behavior contracts, no dynamics.

composites.name: condensate-cahn-hilliard
composites.description: The condensate study flagship: a scalar field phi on a 64x64 fields grid, seeded with near-critical noise (mean 0, uniform +/-0.025 -- the exact np.random.default_rng(0).uniform(-0.025, 0.025, size=(64,64)) draw verified stable/phase-separating in tests/test_cahn_hilliard.py, embedded here as a static array since composite JSON state can't call an RNG at build time), undergoes spinodal decomposition under Cahn-Hilliard dynamics alone (CahnHilliard, pure numpy, no CPM/cobra path at all -- an independent, uncoupled condensate-phase-separation analogue, not a mechanistic model of a specific biomolecular condensate). Each tick runs steps_per_tick=200 explicit CH updates at the pinned-stable M=1.0, kappa=0.5, dt=0.002 (see meta_modelers_guide/condensate/cahn_hilliard.py's stability note); phi_var rises from ~0.0002 (near-flat) toward the coexistence variance as phi separates into +1/-1 domains, while mean(phi) stays conserved near 0 -- verified directly against the module's ch_step over the same seed/params: phi_var reaches ~0.11 by 5000 total steps (tick 25) and ~0.38 by 10000 total steps (tick 50).
